### 🎙️ **Pre-Podcast Call Script – Guest: Mandi S. Goble, Face Fabulous Medical Spa**

---

### **1. Warm Welcome (2 min)**  
“Hi Mandi, thanks again for taking a few minutes to connect — I really appreciate it. I know how busy things get when you’re running a growing aesthetic practice, so I’ll keep this short and focused. My goal is to walk you through how the podcast works, give you a sense of the format, and if it feels like a good fit, we’ll book the actual recording date.”

---

### **Who I Am + Podcast Purpose**  
"I'm building a platform that highlights bold, innovative voices in aesthetic medicine. This podcast is all about real conversations with leaders like you—people who are doing the work, building strong client relationships, and using their expertise to deliver real results.”

“For your episode, we’d talk about your journey as an advanced injector, your approach to creating customized, results-driven treatment plans, and how you’ve built trust with women in the Clarksville area. It’s a relaxed format meant to inspire other providers and practice owners, while also giving you a space to showcase your expertise.”

“My goal is to create episodes that feel authentic, give value to the industry, and help highlight what makes practices like Face Fabulous truly stand out.”

(Pause briefly and let her settle in.)

---

### **Optional Personal Add-In**  
“I came across your work and was really impressed by your focus on natural, goal-oriented results using injectables like Dysport, Sculptra, and fillers. It’s clear you really care about helping your clients look and feel their best—without the overdone look.”

“Given your hands-on role and the personal brand you’ve built at Face Fabulous, I think your story and insights will really resonate with our audience—mostly other injectors, med spa owners, and aesthetic entrepreneurs focused on growth and excellence.”

---

### **2. Podcast Overview (3 min)**  
This is a short-format interview, about 30 to 40 minutes total. We keep it unscripted and conversational—more like a friendly chat than a formal interview.

We’ll explore things like:
- Your role and vision at Face Fabulous  
- Your unique approach to client care and consultations  
- How you create and communicate treatment plans with Dysport, Fillers, Sculptra, etc.  
- Lessons from growing your brand and building community trust  
- Any systems, routines, or client retention tools that have worked well for you  
- What’s next for your practice and how you're continuing to grow  

We record over Zoom, and I handle all the editing. You’ll get a full preview before anything goes live.

**Trust Reminder:**  
“Nothing gets published without your full approval. You’ll be able to review the final cut before we share it.”

---

### **3. Time Commitment & Flow (2 min)**  
“The recording block is about 40 minutes. We’ll do the main recorded part for 15–20 minutes, then stop and spend a few minutes in casual, off-the-record conversation. Honestly, that’s when some of the best ideas surface.”

If it feels appropriate, I can also share some insights I’ve seen working for other injectors or med spas—totally optional, of course.

**Does that format work for you?”**  
(*Wait for confirmation*)

---

### **4. Book the Recording Date (3–5 min)**  
“Perfect. Let’s get something on the calendar. I’ll send a Zoom link and a brief call rundown. What’s your availability like in the next week or so?”

(Suggest 2–3 ideal time slots and confirm.)

“I’ll also send over a quick Guest Primer—it covers what to expect, sample questions, and how to prepare (though no prep is really needed). If there’s anything you’d love to cover specifically, feel free to let me know!”

---

### **5. Close + Confirmation (1–2 min)**  
“Awesome — I’m genuinely excited to have you on the show, Mandi. Thanks again for taking the time, and I’ll see you on [DATE + TIME]. Keep an eye out for the invite and prep sheet!”

---

Here’s a **complete guest primer document** for Mandi & Tony Goble, tailored for your podcast episode and including their background, structure, questions, and prep details:

---

# 🎙️ **Guest Primer – The Aesthetic Edge Podcast**  
**For: Mandi & Tony Goble, Founders of Face Fabulous Medical Spa**  
**Recording Date:** Wednesday, July 2nd at 4:00 PM CST  
**Platform:** Riverside.fm (Link to follow separately)

---

## 🔍 **Episode Overview**  
This episode will spotlight the founders of Face Fabulous Medical Spa — a boutique regenerative aesthetic practice redefining facial rejuvenation for women over 40. Mandi S. Goble, an advanced injector, leads the charge in biofillers made from the patient’s own plasma, while her husband Tony oversees the operations and systems behind the scenes.

Together, they’ve built a highly personalized, education-driven practice that prioritizes natural results, continuity of care, and real human connection — all without chasing scale. This conversation will highlight their innovation, philosophy, and vision for the future of aesthetics.

---

## 🧠 **Topics We’ll Explore**
We’ll keep things casual but insightful. Think of it more as a conversation than an interview. Some of what we’ll cover:

### **1. Your Role & Vision**
- How Mandi and Tony divide responsibilities (injecting vs. operations)
- The story behind Face Fabulous’ transition from Leavenworth to Clarksville
- Why Mandi shifted to regenerative aesthetics — and how plasma-based biofillers are changing the game

### **2. Business Lessons & Team Building**
- Lessons from building a close-knit, trusted team  
- How Tony’s military background shaped the backend structure  
- Why continuity of care matters — and what clients truly want in a provider  

### **3. Systems & Tools That Helped You Scale Smart**
- What tools help streamline operations and patient care  
- How you balance flexibility in scheduling with high patient volumes  
- Insights into delivering 15–28 patients per day without burnout  

### **4. Guest Experience: Elegance Meets Accessibility**
- How Face Fabulous stays approachable while offering cutting-edge care  
- The weekly education strategy and its impact on patient trust  
- Why you’ve resisted the trend of growing big and going corporate  

### **5. What’s Next for Face Fabulous**
- What success looks like in the next 6–12 months  
- Any evolving service areas or focus on mentorship/education  
- How you’re staying grounded as innovators and leaders  

---

## 🎯 **Guiding Questions (During Recording)**

### 3.1 About Your Role & Business
- “Can you share a bit about your role and how it fits into the bigger picture at Face Fabulous?”
- “What does a typical day look like for you?”

### 3.2 Industry Trends
- “What major shifts are you seeing in the aesthetics/med spa industry right now?”
- “How has increased competition or rising patient expectations impacted your growth strategy?”

### 3.3 Current State
- “What’s working well for you right now, and what’s been frustrating?”
- “Which metrics are you most focused on improving — retention, patient lifetime value, treatment conversions?”

### 3.4 Future Goals
- “Where do you want to be six or twelve months from now?”
- “If you could solve one major challenge today, what would it be?”

### 🔁 **Probing Follow-Ups**
- “That’s interesting — can you expand on that?”
- “Do you think this is an industry-wide issue or more unique to your practice?”

---

## ✅ **Logistics**
- **Recording Platform:** Riverside.fm (you’ll receive a separate link to join)
- **Length:** We’ll record for ~40 minutes; final episode will be edited down to ~20 minutes
- **Editing & Approval:** You’ll receive the edited episode for full review/approval before anything is published

---

## 💬 **At the End of the Episode**
I’ll wrap up with a quick thank you and give you the chance to let listeners know:
- How they can find your practice
- Any links or social media you’d like to share  

---

## 📌 **Action Items**
### For Bethany Gifford:
- [x] Send Riverside.fm link  
- [x] Confirm July 2nd at 4pm CST  
- [x] Send final episode for guest approval  

### For Mandi & Tony:
- [ ] Review this guest primer  
- [ ] Block off 40 minutes on July 2nd  
- [ ] Come as you are — no formal prep needed, just bring your story  

---
